info.title: Settly Core API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP API contract for the Settly real estate platform. Implements RFC 9457 error taxonomy, strict validation, and bilingual domain entities.

post.summary: RAG retrieval — visibility-filtered semantic search over the knowledge corpus
post.description: Embeds the query, retrieves top-K chunks from the RAG corpus filtered by the actor's visibility scope (PUBLIC/PARTY/PRIVATE per RAG.md §5). Returns `abstain: true` when no chunks survive the relevance floor — the correct response is 'I don't have information on that'. Authentication is optional — anonymous callers receive PUBLIC chunks only.

200.description: RAG retrieval result (may have abstain: true)
